hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm install && npx playwright install chromium && ./scripts/setup-work-folder && if ! command -v doppler &>/dev/null; then curl -Ls --tlsv1.2 --proto '=https' --retry 3 https://cli.doppler.com/install.sh | sh; fi && if [ -n "$DOPPLER_TOKEN" ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ]; then doppler secrets download --no-file --format env-no-quotes --token "$DOPPLER_TOKEN" | sed 's/^/export /' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; fi
